text:
sophia: thinking out loud: what if we had a 'sleeping guard' mode for config applies that delays route activation until a short live-check passes? helps avoid silent regressions from under-tested routes.

marc: can you clarify "live-check"? like run a thin health probe against each route variant?

sophia: yeah. flow: commit -> shadow activation + synthetic smoke calls -> if smoke passes for X% of sampled keys, flip active. else keep sleeping and surface diagnostics.

jia: i like it but worried about synthetic coverage. how do we pick keys to exercise routing logic?

sophia: use deterministic sampling seeds derived from commit_id so reruns are repeatable. pick top-K keys per-tenancy plus a weighted random sample.

marc: telemetry-wise, need quick indicators: routing-path-match, response-code drift, p95 delta, and token-cost delta. also a compact pass/fail flag per route.

ops-bot: checklist: new RBAC scope configs.commit.sleep, add smoke harness job, add signed sleep_report in ledger, and add retention 3d.

jia: privacy: synthetic smoke must not use real customer payloads. use synthetic templates with header fidelity. redaction doesn't apply.

sophia: good catch. synth templates + a conservatively small key set to avoid hitting quotas. also allow operator override to force activation when needed.

marc: API sketch: POST /configs/commit?sleep_guard=true body {commit_id, smoke: {duration_s, sample_pct, key_seed}} returns sleep_id and signed_report_url when done.

sophia: idempotency: sleep_id = HMAC(commit_id + seed). reports are immutable. UI shows sleep status and a small fail reason list.

jia: edge-case: if some routes never get exercised by smoke run, mark as 'untested' and require manual review before activation.

sophia: agreed. default policy: block auto-activation if any route is 'untested' or any route fails smoke; operators can override with explicit reason. ledger records actor and comment.

marc: test plan: add unit tests for idempotency, smoke harness integration test, and a canary that runs on staging before GA.

ops-bot: scheduled: RFC + PoC next week. add oncall drill for sleep failures.

sophia: i'll draft RFC and a small PoC that returns a signed sleep_report. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
